# Replay fixtures

These fixtures belong to the library module so its graphics tests and benchmarks
work without the examples module. `layout.html` and `platform.html` snapshot the
perf-complex and platform examples. Update them deliberately when changing the
scenarios, rather than loading a downstream example at runtime.

`flowers.jpg` and `coast.jpg` are the CC0 1.0 photos copied by css-masking from
Spotify track-02.jpg and track-21.jpg. `alpha-half.png` originates in Blinkless's
mask fixtures. The originals remain in the examples for application use.
